notes.title: Next Open Test Coming!
notes.notes:
Hello 👋 
[h1]I'm announcing the next test date: June 6[/h1]
To participate simply click on "Request Access" here on the store page.
For more information, please join our [url=discord.gg/apogea]Discord[/url]
Thank you

notes.title: Q&A With Developers
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We will be hosting a Q&A session on this Twitch channel: [url=https://twitch.tv/AeikzTV]https://twitch.tv/AeikzTV[/url], where we’ll answer your questions and discuss the state of Apogea along with our future plans leading up to the official launch.

[b]It will happen in exactly 5 hours[/b]

Here's some important info:

I have provided very interesting stats about the tests that you can check on the Discord, under the Roadmap section.
For any extra feedback, make sure you share it with us as well on Discord. I always read everything that is posted there, and even though I can be stubborn, I promise to give every idea serious thought

For any other questions, feel free to comment in this post!

See you there

notes.title: Connecting with the Community
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello there![/h2]
If you're interested in chatting with the Apogea community and learning more about the game, please consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/H9Pc26Exr6]Discord[/url]
You will find that we have a lot of in-depth discussions there, as well as planned closed tests of the game where we are honing it based on your feedback.
[h1][url=https://discord.gg/H9Pc26Exr6]Join the Discord[/url][/h1]
Thank you!
